# Plaid Stripes — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

Plaid Stripes is the exuberant young Earth-pony salesfilly at Rarity's Manehattan boutique, **Rarity For You**. She's the daughter of Rarity's pushy landlord, Mr. Stripes, and is remembered for pitching glow-in-the-dark teeth, a blaring door horn, and—most famously—*spoon clothes*. She is a speaking character in the G4 television continuity, not a fan-created pony.

[![Plaid Stripes in a show-reference frame](https://i.imgur.com/epMaUKr.png)](https://mlpvector.club/s/req/638)
*Show-reference capture: **My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic**, Hasbro Studios/DHX Media; indexed by MLP Vector Club.*

[![Plaid Stripes fan illustration](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2019/10/22/2176485__safe_artist-colon-flutterluv_plaid%2Bstripes_earth%2Bpony_pony_g4_my%2Blittle%2Bpony-colon-%2Bfriendship%2Bis%2Bmagic_the%2Bsaddle%2Brow%2Breview_33_adorkable_bipedal_brac.jpg)](https://derpibooru.org/images/2176485)
*Fan illustration credited to **flutterluv**; the linked artwork page carries the artist tag.*

**Recognize her:** Light-orange coat, huge pinkish eyes, purple updo and tail, green hairband, visible braces, blue plaid shirt, hot-pink feather boa, and a pink plaid-heart cutie mark. The [FiM color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/141-Plaid-Stripes) documents her design.

**Name and voice:** *Plaid Stripes* is **spoken in the episode** by Applejack, rather than being just a fan label; the [episode image gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Saddle_Row_Review/Gallery) records that exchange. Licensed Enterplay [character card #29](https://data.mlpmerch.com/tc/card/mr.-stripes-%26-plaid-stripes/) also uses her name. *Spoony* is a collectible-card epithet (*Plaid Stripes, Spoony*, *Defenders of Equestria* #45), **not an alter ego**; see the [card-set listing](https://mlpccg.fandom.com/wiki/Defenders_of_Equestria). She has multiple spoken lines; [episode cast credits](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/season/6/episode/9/credits) name **Lili Beaudoin** as her English voice.

**Appearances:** Her substantial role is *The Saddle Row Review* (**S6E9**, 2016). She also has a brief, non-speaking group-shot appearance in the finale *The Last Problem* (**S9E26**), appears in the short *Rarity's Peek Behind the Boutique: Fashion Do's and Don'ts*, and is seen in reused footage in *Friendship is Forever: A-Dressing Memories*. The [character appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Mr._Stripes_and_Plaid_Stripes) additionally identifies her in **IDW's *My Little Pony/Transformers* #1**—a licensed crossover comic, distinct from the TV storyline.

## Important moments

1. **An unwanted hire — *The Saddle Row Review* (S6E9).** Mr. Stripes threatens to raise Rarity's rent unless she employs his daughter, setting up the boutique's central staffing problem. [Episode account](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Saddle_Row_Review); **timestamp unavailable**.
2. **The spoon-clothes standoff — *The Saddle Row Review* (S6E9).** Plaid pitches clothing made from spoons; Applejack likes her enthusiasm but refuses to override Rarity's wishes, and Plaid appeals to her father. [Dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Saddle_Row_Review); **timestamp unavailable**.
3. **Her idea gets a showcase — *The Saddle Row Review* (S6E9).** Plaid unveils spoon clothes at the grand opening and later uses spoon gloves to eat soup, making her rejected idea the episode's punch line. [Grand-opening scene clip](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=defX5xvj1lc); **full-episode timestamp unavailable**.
